# Material assets

PBR materials and HDR environment from Poly Haven, CC0:
- Stone wall: https://polyhaven.com/a/stone_wall_02
- Wood decking: https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_floor_deck
- Ground: https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_grass_rock
- Sky: https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky

Downloaded at 1K resolution for this real-time scene. Color, normal and roughness maps are local files. No runtime external asset requests are required.

- Stone paving: https://polyhaven.com/a/stone_pavers
- Scanned tree: https://polyhaven.com/a/island_tree_02
- Scanned shrub: https://polyhaven.com/a/shrub_03
- Potted plant: https://polyhaven.com/a/potted_plant_01

Vegetation GLTF geometry, texture maps and alpha masks are stored locally under `../models/`.
